[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]You were waiting? Were you not[XENO:n ]
sealed here by our Founder?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

I forged the Monado. It is moulded from me.[XENO:n ]
All who wield the sword are made known to me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT13 ]You made the Monado?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Yes. [XENO:wait wait=key ]
I made it millennia ago to oppose Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
But why are you imprisoned?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Monado controls the principle upon which life[XENO:n ]
is based, the source of your existence - ether.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Master the principle of life and all things will bow to you.[XENO:n ]
Your power would be infinite.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

As you now know, the sword gives the[XENO:n ]
wielder the power of foresight.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

And I myself once used that sword against[XENO:n ]
the Machine God, and defeated it.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]You're telling us you beat the Machine God[XENO:n ]
with that tiny thing?![XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Its appearance is merely an illusion.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Its form morphs to conform[XENO:n ]
to the will of its master.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
The power comes from within.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:line len=2 ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

But its power was feared by some. That is why the[XENO:n ]
High Entia imprisoned me here long ago.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT4 ]Impossible! That the Founders[XENO:n ]
would do it for such a reason...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
You are what you are.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Do you not believe your own eyes?[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Open your mind![XENO:n ]
New ruler of the High Entia.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

The Monado is the blade of the Giant God.[XENO:n ]
The only force that can oppose the Machine God.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

As the wielder grows, so too does his[XENO:n ]
ability to control all things.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Yet there is still power trapped in the sword.[XENO:n ]
The Monado is in shackles.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shackles?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It is suppressed.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT7 ]You mean...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
